text:
Sanjay Patel: quick ping — noticing a weird regression on L40S during the longctx 32k sweep vs A100/H100. baseline numbers below, can someone take a focused microbench?

Sanjay Patel: context: model=redwood/long-ctx-4b, seq=32768, batch=2, kv-cache=on.
- A100 (node a100-11): p99 ~1.2s/token
- H100 (node h100-05): p99 ~1.15s/token
- L40S (node l40s-03): p99 ~1.8s/token

Sanjay Patel: NVTX traces show an extra memcpy around step ~5120 on L40S and a fallback to a non-optimized kernel for the attention loop when seq > 8k. PR #4827 touched tiling heuristics — could be related.

Olivia Gomez: I can queue a focused overnight run on l40s-03. Which exact runner args do you want me to use?

Sanjay Patel: please run the minimal reproducer:
```
bench_runner --model redwood/long-ctx-4b \n             --ctx 32768 \n             --batch 2 \n             --kv-cache on \n             --profile nvtx \n             --warmup 5 \n             --iter 50 \n             --save-trace /tmp/longctx-l40s-32k.trace
```
include both `--no-prefetch` and `--prefetch` variants (two runs).

Tim Nguyen: quick local check: I ran batch=1, seq=32k on h100-05 and a100-11. results: h100 p99 1.15s/token, a100 p99 1.25s/token. On l40s-03 i reproduced p99 ~1.9s/token.

Tim Nguyen: small nvprof excerpt (L40S) — see the memcpy spike around token 5120: 
```
[5120] memcpy H2D  24ms  (device -> host ?)
[5121] kernel(attn_fwd) launch overhead 1.8ms (non-optimized path)
[5122] memcpy D2H  26ms
```
Seems like a path that goes through a CPU bounce for some intermediate KV chunk.

Jen Park: fyi kernel team pushed fallback heuristics yesterday in #4827 (rollout on canary). They purposely fall back when workspace>X to avoid OOMs. Might be conservatively tripping for longctx.

Jen Park: tagging kernel owners @tim for traces and @olivia for L40S run. Also adding request to try the quantized kernel variant (it uses different tiling).

bench-bot: scheduled job 2181234600 -> cluster=eng-longctx, nodes=[l40s-03], job=longctx-sweep-32k, ETA ~9h, config=two-runs-{no-prefetch,prefetch}. Logs will appear in /jobs/2181234600/logs once done.

Olivia Gomez: ack — starting the two runs now, will post raw traces and perf summary. ETA ~8.5h.

Sanjay Patel: thanks. Tim — can you grep the h100/a100 traces for any memcpy entries at the same step index to rule out model scheduling differences? If not, let's escalate kernel heuristics.

Tim Nguyen: will do. quick grep output from h100 trace: no memcpy at 5120, attn kernel uses optimized path for all steps.

Tim Nguyen: also noticed an additional 6-8ms per-token jitter on L40S even when memcpy not present — could be small kernel launch overhead compounding.

Olivia Gomez: job 2181234600 finished (ran both configs). attaching short summary:
- no-prefetch: p50 0.42s/token, p95 0.78s/token, p99 1.85s/token
- prefetch: p50 0.40s/token, p95 0.72s/token, p99 1.62s/token
traces uploaded: /jobs/2181234600/logs/trace-no-prefetch.trace, trace-prefetch.trace

Olivia Gomez: note: prefetch helps but doesn't close the gap to H100/A100. I can prod kernel team for a revert if we confirm #4827 is the culprit.

Sanjay Patel: ok next steps:
- @Tim: compare step-level nvtx traces across devices, paste diff of kernel launch times around token 4k-6k (helps rule scheduling).
- @Jen: pls check canary rollout for #4827 and add a toggle to disable the conservative fallback for longctx heavy workloads.
- @Olivia: thanks for runs — please attach the raw `nvprof --csv` for the suspicious region.

Jen Park: filing a quick follow-up with kernel team (KF-211) to add a longctx opt-in toggle and test matrix (A100/H100/L40S). I'll include the sample traces.

Sanjay Patel: thanks all. ping me if you need extra capacity or if you want me to live-debug on L40S. :thumbsup:

Tim Nguyen: pasted diff snippet (h100 vs l40s) — small table:
- h100 attn_fwd avg_launch 0.9ms
- a100 attn_fwd avg_launch 1.1ms
- l40s attn_fwd avg_launch 1.8ms + memcpy spikes at index 5120 (24-28ms)

Tim Nguyen: conclusion: likely combined effect of conservative tiling fallback + occasional memcpy path on L40S. Kernel team toggle should confirm.

Olivia Gomez: i'm going to run an extra variant with `--workspace-limit 0.7` (forces different tiling) and will post results in the morning.

bench-bot: job 2181234600 logs archived -> /jobs/2181234600/logs. bench-runner artifacts: /artifacts/2181234600/*

Sanjay Patel: excellent. we'll reconvene after Jen's kernel quick-fix. keeping this thread for follow-ups.
